methodology: Unchanged 24 fixtures. Release builds. Fresh processes/profiles, no learning, no neural model. One cold request then one full warmup pass, followed by 20 passes alternating engine order. Then five fresh-process startup trials per engine, alternating order, with OS file caches warm. Sequential subprocess calls, no HTTP. Exact whole-sentence first-choice comparison only; Mozc alternatives are per segment. Valid spelling variants count as misses. Internal timers have slightly different boundaries; subprocess round trips include serialization for both.
